newsitem.title: USA: Comsat plans to sell satellite dish unit-Post.
newsitem.headline: Comsat plans to sell satellite dish unit-Post.

text.p: Comsat Corp plans to announce a major restructuring on Monday that includes selling its satellite-dish manufacturing business, the Washington Post reported in Monday editions.

The newspaper quoted Comsat's president and chief executive Betty Alewine as saying the company would put its RSI Inc. division up for sale because it was considered extraneous to Comsat's core mission of providing satellite services to businesses and governments worldwide.
"We are going to be a smaller company," Alewine told the newspaper. "We are going to be financially stronger and more focused. The era of diversity is over."
The Comsat board of directors approved the restructuring plan on Friday, Alewine told the Post.
